title: EC2 instances in a region
description: Lists EC2 instances in one region with type, state, addressing and network placement.

outputs.name: instanceState
outputs.description: State object; the name key holds running, stopped, etc.

outputs.name: ipAddress
outputs.description: Public IPv4 address, empty when none

cost.notes: One describe call per region when swept account-wide

template: SELECT instanceId, instanceType, instanceState, privateIpAddress, ipAddress, launchTime, vpcId, subnetId FROM aws.ec2_native.instances WHERE region = '{{region}}';
notes: instanceState is an object; filter on its name key (running, stopped, terminated) client-side or with JSON extraction. Terminated instances remain visible for about an hour after termination. ipAddress is empty for instances with no public IP.
